chunks: Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī ibn Maḥbūb narrated from al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd, from Jaʿfar, from his father, from ʿAlī عليه السلام, who said:
There is no compensation due upon a fornicator, and there is no hadd punishment upon a woman who was coerced.

key_terms.عُقْرٌ: compensation or indemnity mentioned in this legal context
key_terms.مُسْتَكْرَهَةٍ: a woman who has been coerced or forced

ai.seo_question: Is a woman who is forced into zina subject to hadd punishment in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning zina. It establishes that the coerced woman is not subject to hadd punishment, distinguishing between voluntary wrongdoing and compulsion in legal accountability.
